Profile

Bloom Holding is an Abu Dhabi-based group that combines property development with education, hospitality, landscaping and facilities management. It forms part of the National Holding group, and its offices are at Bloom Central on Airport Road. The company has been active in the capital since the late 2000s, with a portfolio that now includes gated villa communities, mixed-use buildings and serviced residences in Abu Dhabi, as well as projects in Dubai and Al Ain.

Its largest residential undertaking is Bloom Living in Zayed City, a Spanish- and Mediterranean-inspired community planned across about 2.2 million square metres with more than 4,500 homes, a town centre, parks and schools, released over successive phases. Earlier work includes Bloom Gardens on the Eastern Mangrove Corniche, the Soho Square and Park View buildings on Saadiyat Island, and Bloom Marina at Al Bateen. Through Bloom Education, the group is also linked to several international schools in the UAE.

Key areas of activity

  • Master-planned residential communities
  • Mixed-use and waterfront developments
  • Education (Bloom Education)
  • Hospitality, landscaping and facilities management
